note: Interior ministry web page on police policy, its figures stated for 2014 under a later 'Perspectives pour l'année 2025' heading. It names no police information system: it states an intention to acquire unnamed software applications to modernise and secure the sensitive data the Police handles, the equipping of services with computer hardware in 2014 (enabling), and identity-card, passport and visa processing. Nothing on how commissariats or posts record reports or cases.
